name: Bedrock core list
note: The 4,000 most common Spanish words. Word order derived from wordfreq data (CC BY-SA 4.0, https://github.com/rspeer/wordfreq), dictionary forms from simplemma (MIT), meanings written for Bedrock. "p" is the word split into syllables with the stressed one in capitals.

to him, to her, to you (polite)
to pass, to happen, to spend (time)
to carry, to take, to wear
to wait, to hope, to expect
to take out, to get (a grade)
to go up, to climb, to upload
to go down, to lower, to download
to try, to taste, to prove
gift (talent), title of respect for a man
to look (appearance), to see each other
to thank, to be grateful for
to mark, to dial, to score
to get wrong (equivocarse: to make a mistake)
to drive, to manage, to handle
to exercise (a right), to practice (a profession)
to think, to give an opinion
to order, to put in charge
to start (an engine), to pull out
to bear, to put up with
to put up with, to hold
to consist of, to be on record
to make happy (alegrarse: to be glad)
to put to bed (acostarse: to go to bed)
